note: One default rule per scenario, the other official codes of the scenario are permitted alternatives (tax_determination_alternative, ADR-026): the caller supplies S02, S81, S82, K110 and so on where the facts require it, the core records the difference. Alternatives that name a code not applied under the chosen vat_profile are skipped. The default of every purchase scenario is the full-deduction code, also for the mixed business types 2 and 4: which costs are common costs (pro rata) and which are purely taxable is a judgement per line or account, not something the package can decide (CHANGELOG F-DK-15). Priority: the lowest value wins first (ADR-192). Domestic rules (20) beat the EU rules (50) so that DK to DK never takes an EU rule, because origin_eu and destination_eu are true for DK as well. Rules marked requires_delta use the derived keys of ADR-200 (origin_eu, destination_eu, specified in 07, 8.4, implementation pending). Not covered: B2C distance sales (OSS, codes S61 to S65), partnerless documents beyond the explicit-country rule of 08, 3.1. A sale to an EU consumer is rejected with TAX.NO_RULE_MATCHED. Purchases from the EU do not use partner_vat_status: the status is evaluated in the destination country (DK) and a foreign supplier is NOT_REGISTERED there (08, 3.1)

objects.note: Import. The official return text puts VAT on goods bought abroad (EU and non-EU) in one box and as input VAT, so import is a reverse-charge pair, not input VAT paid at customs
